displayName: Invoice approval with a branch gate
description: Extract the details from an invoice, ask a human whether to pay it, then schedule the payment only when the decision is pay.

activation.when: Use when the user wants an invoice reviewed and, if approved, scheduled for payment.

steps.description: Read the invoice and extract vendor, total and due date.
steps.instruction: Read {{inputs.invoice_url}} and extract the vendor, total and due date.

steps.description: Pause for a human to pay or reject the invoice.
steps.question: Pay this invoice from {{inputs.invoice_url}}?

steps.description: Schedule the payment for the extracted amount.
steps.instruction: Schedule payment of the extracted total to the extracted vendor.
